assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story and asset atlas. Make one perfectly regular 3-column by 3-row atlas of nine distinct independent square images, warm ivory gutters at the exact thirds. First-grade original Chinese illustrated lesson in a community kite exhibition workshop. Quiet matte gouache, fine paper grain, clear cut-paper edges, deep pine, apricot, persimmon, pale blue and warm cream. No text, numbers, letters, logos, watermarks, textbook artwork, unsafe tools, or extra objects overlapping the tile borders. TOP LEFT: two East Asian primary school children in cream and mint sweaters lean toward a bare low table, smiling, a simple colorful paper kite with ribbon tail hangs above; scene establishes a kite display workshop, intentionally no building blocks in the front of this image. TOP MIDDLE: one obviously elongated rectangular orange cardboard package, all three different dimensions readable from a quiet three-quarter view, sharp flat closed faces, no tape edges affecting outer geometry, centered on pale cream. TOP RIGHT: one compact, equal-edge blue cube wooden gift box without ribbon, same face lengths and no lid projection, shown in three-quarter view, isolated on pale cream. MIDDLE LEFT: one plain pale green short circular wooden dowel with flat parallel same-sized circular ends, upright, no taper, no rim or handles, on pale cream. MIDDLE CENTER: one smooth apricot rubber practice ball with a single soft painted curved highlight, no base or flat side, isolated on pale cream. MIDDLE RIGHT: quiet empty kite-workshop shelf with pine beams, a single paper kite high on the rear wall, broad uncluttered center, paper texture, no people. BOTTOM LEFT: same two children from the first tile sitting at a low cream-colored worktable, pointing to an empty area where pieces will be placed, obvious collaborative gestures, no blocks yet. BOTTOM MIDDLE: adult family member and child at home at a low clear worktable, child points to a drawing on blank paper where only a simple branching line without text is visible, adult listening, paper remains blank of letters. BOTTOM RIGHT: a single small apricot-and-mint geometric paper diamond kite with a short ribbon tail on cream, no writing or pattern at center, decorative lesson completion picture. Maintain gentle daylight and avoid visual clutter.
